<thought>The observed isotopic envelope shows a strong M peak at 224 Da with decreasing peaks at +1, +2, +3 Da etc., matching the characteristic 13C distribution for a molecule containing many carbons (≈18 C). No other element shows a distinctive pattern (e.g., Cl, Br, S). Therefore the only element that can be definitively identified from the isotope pattern is carbon.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
